Name: Meshullam, Father of Jahzerah
Summary: Father of Jahzerah in the Jerusalem priest list, son of Meshillemith.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:12: Father of Jahzerah in the Jerusalem priest list, son of Meshillemith.
LifeLesson: The mention of Meshullam in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
